description:
FILED s531a (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-01), split out of #1705 (closed by s531a with its %Config half: extensions / dynamic_ext / d_getpbyname).

#1705's ORDER item (3): t/run/locale.t does `eval { require POSIX; POSIX->import("locale_h") }` and skips the whole file when it fails; lib/POSIX.pm exists but has no `locale_h` tag (setlocale, localeconv, the LC_* constants) -- 44 perl rows never produced.  Independent of the %Config change and cheap per #1705: add the tag to lib/POSIX.pm's %EXPORT_TAGS with the names PCL implements (rule 9a: shim data), then measure t/run/locale.t's next wall (it un-skips 44 rows that will mostly need a real setlocale).  Companion rows: run/locale.t (perl-suite-fails *summary*, row-shortfall 44), re-caused to this task by s531a.
subject: lib/POSIX.pm has no `locale_h` export tag: `eval { require POSIX; POSIX->import("locale_h") }` fails, so t/run/locale.t skip_alls ("could not load the POSIX module") -- the third part of #1705
